records.idCN: 休息节点/休息节点
03Boss事件/难度02/01第一位面/Boss1
records.name: Singularity
records.des: The snowflakes tell a story. The abomination has descended. On the land, across the mist of frost.

records.idCN: 01普通战斗/难度01/01第一位面/小怪01
records.name: Battle
records.des: In the rapidly changing space, the past emerges in an unfriendly manner.

records.idCN: 商店事件/商店1
奇遇事件/普通/散落的书籍
records.name: Scattered Books
records.des: There are no signs of the bookshelf collapsing or being bumped, but the books that should have been on the shelf are piled messily and scattered on the floor. Perhaps a librarian is needed here... or maybe a reader?
records.bookDes: It seems that a more competent librarian is needed here.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/指引灯光
records.name: Guiding Light
records.des: The floating guidance robot is hovering in mid-air, in a waiting status. Simply command it to "follow" or "lead," and it will take the corresponding action.
records.bookDes: Be a moth drawn to the light, or the one holding the lamp.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/神秘光束
records.name: Mysterious Beam
records.des: Bright light shines from the corner ahead, for some reason making you feel very familiar... even giving a feeling of being "home." But why is there such warm lighting in this kind of space?
records.bookDes: Follow the light...

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/求真者
records.name: Truthseeker
records.des: Between the towering bookshelves, a translucent figure wanders... It seems to be someone from Source Citadel. But strangely, you cannot see her appearance clearly. There's only a faint sense of nostalgia, as if you've seen this scene long ago.
records.bookDes: ...Is it her?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/墙中右手
records.name: Right Hand in the Wall
records.des: A steel right arm protrudes from the wall, its surface covered with scratches and dents. The palm is open and slightly shaking, as if waiting for something — perhaps a weapon, an important object, or a person's hand.
records.bookDes: A right hand, representing the laws of equality, giving, and mutual aid.

records.idCN: 回血事件/八音石01
records.name: Musical Rock
records.des: You hear the gurgling sound of running water, yet there is no water in sight. Following the sound, you stumble upon a massive, wondrous rock. It seems to weave an unparalleled exquisite melody from all manner of natural sounds. You can't help but pause and linger, lost in its tune.
records.bookDes: "In a distant land, I sing, I call... Let my hands become the arms of the mountain, let my branches become a song."

records.idCN: 休息节点/强化铺
休息节点/招募
休息节点/复活
奇遇事件/普通/许愿池
records.name: Wishing Lake
records.des: The closer you get to this lake, the more your doubts increase. Why would such a place have an exquisite lake? Why does it seem to be glowing? And why is there a hastily written note next to it saying "You can jump into or drink from it"...?
records.bookDes: If you throw something into the lake, will your wish come true?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/思乡曲
records.name: Nostalgic Melody
records.des: As you walk through the passage, you suddenly hear a melodious sound drifting from afar. Strangely, the melody of this tune seems different to each listener, yet one thing is the same — it makes everyone long for the past and their hometown.
records.bookDes: "Make my wish come true; let me return to my hometown."

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/紧闭门扉
records.name: Closed Door
records.des: Faced with a tightly shut door, if one must get through, there are only two methods an ordinary person can think of...\nTo be precise, there is only one.
records.bookDes: A door that no one will come to open for you, no matter how much you knock.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/断裂线缆
records.name: Broken Cable
records.des: You see the severed end of the cable hanging down into the water on the ground, occasionally crackling with dangerous electrical sparks... How could there be a safety hazard this serious?! Who on earth did this?!
records.bookDes: Be careful with electrical safety!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/突发停电
records.name: Sudden Blackout
records.des: The fork ahead is pitch-black. Unlike a normal power outage, the emergency lights have not come on, and an unsettling presence emanates from the thick darkness... Do you want to choose this path?
records.bookDes: Where is the main switch?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/昴昴朋友
records.name: Tauree Taury
records.des: Although there have been several previous encounters with these Tauri robots under Rebis's control, this is the first time seeing one that can project a cute smiling face. In Rebis's own words, "I can have my little ones lead you around or help you out."
records.bookDes: "Hello! I'm your Tauree friend. What do you need?"

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/废弃车站
records.name: 废弃车站
records.des: 随着你踏入这片空间，周围的景象便开始进行不可逆的改变——很快，你便置身于一处荒凉的车站月台上。周围的通道四通八达，通往餐厅、交易所、列车长休息区……这是怎么回事？
records.bookDes: 你最熟悉的归处之一。

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/自动工坊
records.name: Automated Workshop
records.des: An ancient production facility still in operation, but its production process seems to have fallen into some kind of infinite loop. Through simple research, you restart the production process, and now you have complete control over this machine.
records.bookDes: This is the charm of full automation!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/熟悉的图书馆
records.name: Familiar Library
records.des: Once again in a familiar space, your heart is filled with peace. Perhaps this is a memory belonging to someone quite familiar with the Confluence Tower. Every scene is exactly the same as in your memory.
records.bookDes: Is anyone still here?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/陌生的图书馆
records.name: Unfamiliar Library
records.des: Once again in a familiar space, you feel a slight unease. Perhaps this is a memory belonging to someone quite familiar with the Confluence Tower. The furnishings and the books on the shelves have not changed in the slightest, but this place is clearly "missing" something.
records.bookDes: There is no one here.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/地板塌陷
records.name: Collapsed Floor
records.des: The path ahead looks as if it has once suffered some kind of heavy blow, and the collapsed floor exposes some dangerous pipes. It seems that the ground is still stable enough to support your passage, but you need to tread as lightly as possible.
records.bookDes: Don't get trapped!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/图纸与工坊
records.name: Blueprint and Workshop
records.des: A workshop that has been abandoned for a long time. Many blueprints are scattered about in a mess. You see some extremely advanced designs among them, but they seem unable to be realized due to technical limitations.
records.bookDes: Only with the right design can there be perfect results.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/轨道交通
records.name: Rail Transit
records.des: An ancient vehicle appears before you. You once read in a history book that it was named a "tram," and that after the Morphic Moon incident, it was abandoned before it could be widely adopted. You want to take a closer look at it.
records.bookDes: If it were in a city that was not affected by Morphic Field Pollution...

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/日食
records.name: Solar Eclipse
records.des: A dark void hanging high in the sky continuously spews golden flames outward. You look up at the sun, and an indescribably beautiful melody reaches your ears. Mist shrouds everything around you; only the lighthouse in the distance flickers with a faint light.
records.bookDes: The remains of the sun.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/墙中左手
records.name: Left Hand in the Wall
records.des: A withered left arm abruptly juts out from the mottled wall. The hand steadily holds a bronze balance scale, the left tray is raised high, flashing with a metallic sheen in the dim light; the right tray sinks slightly, and bright red liquid is circulating in the tray.
records.bookDes: A right hand, representing laws of exchange, contribution, and gain.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/势利眼的观测者
records.name: Snobbish Observer
records.des: You find yourself in a familiar clothing shop, a lavishly decorated eyeball hanging from the ceiling. In its eye, you see a gorgeously dressed witch looking at your outfit up and down. The clothes around you are all yours to take.
records.bookDes: "Come on, put on some new clothes to lift your spirits!"

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/塔
records.name: The Tower
records.des: An exquisite model of a tall tower sits on the tabletop. Judging by the strange glow at its top, you can tell that this is a masterfully crafted miniature replica of the Wishing Tower. You wonder whether this scaled-down replica also has the magical ability to grant wishes?
records.bookDes: What is this tower made of?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/唾手可得的奖励
records.name: Rewards at Grasp
records.des: In the center of the empty room sits an exquisite box. The moment you enter the room, the sound of mechanisms echoes, and countless holes appear in the ceiling, walls, and floor. You throw something toward the center of the room, and it is immediately pierced by sharp blades shooting out from the holes.
records.bookDes: Open the box, claim the rewards.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/雾中歌声
records.name: Singing in the Mist
records.des: A thick fog hangs all around. From within the fog comes a faint, unsettlingly eerie voice. That extremely unpleasant singing, almost like a shriek, nearly pierces your eardrums... It seems to be a huge HowlingBox, with much dust scattered around it, completely blocking your path.
records.bookDes: Sing for me!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/墙中大嘴
records.name: Big Mouth in the Wall
records.des: Why is there such a wall inside this space? Why is there such a bottomless gaping mouth on this wall? Looking into that gaping mouth, you vaguely feel that it could devour anything... At the same time, some legends about the gaping mouth surface in your mind.
records.bookDes: Guess you should run if you don't want to be swallowed.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/乐器和乐谱
records.name: Instruments and Sheet
records.des: A faint glimmer floats in the dust, guiding you toward the shelf ahead. On the shelf rest a sheet of music and a violin. They appear to have been well maintained over the years. That sheet of music seems somewhat different from the ones on the surface.
records.bookDes: I play this melody for you, no matter how many times...

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/塔中魔方
records.name: Cube in the Tower
records.des: There is a plaque beside the Cube. On the front it says, "Rotate it to affect the space," and on the back it says, "To the left, face the trial; to the right, abandon wealth."
records.bookDes: A simulation or miniaturization of the space.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/战斗模拟系统
records.name: Combat Simulation
records.des: This room is furnished with a strange device that looks like a gaming console. According to the description beside it, this is a simulated combat training device for internal use within the Destroyer, but it is still in the debugging stage.
records.bookDes: A device full of challenges.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/防御系统故障
records.name: Defense System Failure
records.des: A piercing alarm blares, and the screen beside it displays garbled letters indicating a system error. A mechanical voice warns you that a defense system malfunction has occurred, and the out-of-control defense robots are about to approach.
records.bookDes: A device full of danger.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/黑8
records.name: Black 8
records.des: A billiard ball comes into view. Just as you are about to pick it up, it slips from your fingertips and rolls away. In the very next second, Rebis appears out of thin air. "Young one, did you drop this golden ball, or this silver ball? Of course, whichever one it is, retrieving it will cost you."
records.bookDes: In billiards rules, this is a ball that determines victory.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/狭路相逢
records.name: Inevitable Confrontation
records.des: In the distance, there seems to be a group of workers repairing the facilities. You are surprised to find that these people are the "long-term residents" of Yunxiu Bridge. Of course, they recognize you as well, so they surround you, wearing sinister smiles.
records.bookDes: Prisoner of endless labor.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/倒悬高塔
records.name: The Inverted Tower
records.des: You follow the long staircase upward, only to find that it has led you into a weird tower, where everything inside is completely upside down. When you try to turn back, you see an incredibly heavy door with a strange keyhole blocking your way.
records.bookDes: Ascend step by step, and invert your view.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/隐士
records.name: Hermit
records.des: A ragged-robed figure crouches in the corner, the hood completely shrouding their body. You cannot make out their build or face, or perhaps there is nothing at all beneath the robe... After noticing you, the robe stirs slightly, revealing a box of food from within. Is this meant for you?
records.bookDes: Do you really have to believe someone who won't even show their face...?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/空中魔眼
records.name: Demonic Eye
records.des: A gigantic eyeball floats in the air, and the way its eye moves is somehow unsettling... It seems to be searching for something, wanting to delve into the depths of whatever its gaze falls upon.
records.bookDes: Do your eyes feel a bit uncomfortable?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/锁孔魔方
records.name: Keyhole Cube
records.des: Beside the Cube, there is a plaque and two keys. The front reads, "Insert the key and turn them to affect the space," and the back reads, "If you want to gain something, you must first pay the price."
records.bookDes: The enclosure or liberation of the space.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/镜中魔方
records.name: Cube in the Mirror
records.des: There is a plaque beside the mirror. The front reads, "Taking out the Cube can affect the current space," and the back reads, "With a sincere heart, you can seize opportunities."
records.bookDes: A reflection of space, or its true form.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/普通/猩红色的沙漏
records.name: Crimson Hourglass
records.des: A well-crafted giant hourglass. Its exterior already covered with a layer of dust. But the red crystal inside have not lost their luster. It appears to be some kind of crystal, and stranger still, the crystals in the upper part have not diminished at all.
records.bookDes: A rustling sound like blood...

records.idCN: 02精英战斗/难度01/01第一位面/精英01
records.name: Elite Battle
records.des: Do not let any enemy hinder your resolve to continue exploring; do not be defeated by illusions, keep going.

records.idCN: 宝箱事件/尘埃50
宝箱事件/尘埃100
宝箱事件/直觉·渡越
宝箱事件/直觉·轮转
宝箱事件/直觉·神会
宝箱事件/直觉·时运
宝箱事件/直觉·洞悉
宝箱事件/直觉·天命
宝箱事件/直觉·求生
宝箱事件/直觉·坚守
宝箱事件/直觉·一心
03Boss事件/难度02/01第一位面/Boss2
records.name: Singularity
records.des: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Target: Blastbug Matriarch. Objective: test combat capability against CR groups.

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度02/02第二位面/Boss1
records.name: Singularity
records.des: The mother is immersed in unreachable warmth, and she allows no one to disturb her dream.

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度02/02第二位面/Boss2
records.name: Singularity
records.des: The authority of Tom, the overlord of the wasteland, cannot be challenged!! You say Haima Zaria? What is that?

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度02/03第三位面/Boss1
records.name: Singularity
records.des: A Chaos Remain compounded from many kinds of bizarre bodily tissues appears perfectly suited to a space filled with hallucinations and dreams.

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度02/03第三位面/Boss2
records.name: Singularity
records.des: When you look directly into its hollow eyes, you can feel your body temperature dropping lower and lower.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/骨血终将汇流/主
records.name: We shall reunite, my kin.
records.des: Ahead is a tall young man, his face hidden in shadow. Strangely, you feel an inexplicable sense of closeness. "My blood kin, being mysterious is not my intention... but the time for choice has arrived." He extends a strange arm toward you.
records.bookDes: A choice. A choice about you, him, and everything else.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/多次触发/提灯的私书/01私书与提灯
records.name: Scribe and Lantern
records.des: You are drawn by a warm and familiar light, and discover that the glow comes from the lantern in Valentine's hand. "Although I cannot guide you outside the Fabricate, I may be able to offer some other help." She opens the lantern's shade, and the flame inside flickers, as if it needs some fuel...
records.bookDes: What could be more reassuring than light and knowledge?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/多次触发/提灯的私书/02谜团与提灯
records.name: Mystery and Lantern
records.des: Valentine still keeps a reassuring vigil for you with her lantern. "I don't know why either, but when that dust was used as fuel in the lantern, unprecedented phenomena occurred. If I get the chance, I'll look for answers in the Fabricate"
records.bookDes: What could be more reassuring than light and knowledge?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/多次触发/提灯的私书/03祝福与提灯
records.name: Blessings and Lantern
records.des: When you meet Valentine this time, she has already found the answer in a book. But when you curiously want to press further, she says that it is difficult to express it in plain language. "You only need to remember that this is the blessing the Fabricate bestows upon seekers of knowledge."
records.bookDes: What could be more reassuring than light and knowledge?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/多次触发/娃娃鱼理财/01理财产品
records.name: Financial Product
records.des: You rub your eyes, seemingly unable to believe the scene before you: there's actually a trading center here!? And standing before you is Forton, who warmly invites you to make a deal with him, such as trying his latest financial product. The next time you meet he will repay you with both principal and interest.
records.bookDes: Deposit more, withdraw more, integrity economy!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/多次触发/娃娃鱼理财/02售后纠纷
records.name: Aftersales Dispute
records.des: When you run into Forton again, you immediately ask about the previous investment and demand that he honor his promise. However, he hopes you can wait patiently a little longer; he definitely will not go back on his word. At the same time, he hints that if you invest more money, you can get greater returns.
records.bookDes: Deposit more, withdraw more, integrity economy!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/多次触发/娃娃鱼理财/03打击奸商
records.name: Dishonest Trader
records.des: Before you can call out to stop Forton, he turns and runs the moment he sees you. You immediately understand that there is nothing left for the two of you to talk about; force is the only solution. But he is prepared as well, with several bodyguards around him.
records.bookDes: Deposit more, withdraw more, integrity economy!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/多次触发/素昧平生的骑士/01骑士训练
records.name: Knight Training
records.des: A knight is continuously swinging her sword at the air in front of her, apparently simulating a battle with an enemy. Seeing you approach, she immediately stops practicing, sets her sword heavily to one side, and gives you a gentle smile.
records.bookDes: Comforting arm strength...

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/多次触发/素昧平生的骑士/02骑士的承诺
records.name: Knight's Promise
records.des: You run into that knight again. At the sight of you, she seems even happier than you are. "Fancy meeting you again! Training with you before benefited me greatly — thank you so much! This time, I hope I can be the one to offer some help — please don't hesitate; if there's anything you need, just ask!"
records.bookDes: Comforting arm strength...

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/骨血终将汇流/分支-相信自己的直觉
records.name: We shall reunite, my kin.
records.des: Seeing you hold out your hand, the man turns over his palm, and dust shimmering with a faint glow falls into your hand, piling into a small mountain, then overflowing and falling to the ground... Only then do you realize that this is not dust at all, but a kind of pitch-black, chaotic crystalline substance.
records.bookDes: A choice. A choice about you, him, and everything else.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/扭蛋机/分支-扭扭试试
records.name: Gacha Machine
records.des: Before you have a chance to pick up those two capsules, a terrifying sound suddenly erupts from them... Enemies emerge from inside!
records.bookDes: Just do it!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/扭蛋机/主
records.name: Gacha Machine
records.des: The device before you appears, judging by its shape, to be a... gacha machine? It is filled with all kinds of prizes, but upon closer inspection, you notice that something seems to be writhing inside some of the capsules...
records.bookDes: Just do it!

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/彼如风暴/分支-给你尘埃
records.name: Like a Storm
records.des: Chloe sees the dust you hold out and clicks her tongue. "Not bad, though I didn't expect you to have collected so much... Hmm, I also made some preparations on the way here, so pick what you want from these."
records.bookDes: Can I even describe a person as a "thunderstorm"?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/彼如风暴/主
records.name: Like a Storm
records.des: A sudden gale whips up, accompanied by a terrifying crash of lightning. A petite figure emerges from a small storm that appears out of thin air. "Glad you're still breathing! I'm here to help, believe it or not. But you'll have to give me something in exchange, or we'll all be trapped here, and that's not in my schedule."
records.bookDes: Can I even describe a person as a "thunderstorm"?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/彼如风暴/分支-给你推力
records.name: Like a Storm
records.des: Chloe's eyes light up when she sees the exchange conditions you list. "This is pretty good. I didn't expect you to have such good taste! Come on, hurry up and give it to me!"
records.bookDes: Can I even describe a person as a "thunderstorm"?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/二号躯体/分支-你是雅莱
records.name: Body #2
records.des: The girl mutters in confusion, uttering words you cannot understand. At the same time, you notice that her body is gradually twisting and deforming, transforming into a nonhuman shape, yet she herself seems completely unaware of it!
records.bookDes: Choose her name, choose her mind, choose her body.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/二号躯体/主
records.name: Body #2
records.des: In the middle of an open space encircled by a heap of cluttered experimental equipment, a white-haired girl sits there quietly. Judging by her appearance, she is undoubtedly the Jalhay you know, but she radiates a terrifying aura... The girl slowly raises her head. "Who am I?" she asks.
records.bookDes: Choose her name, choose her mind, choose her body.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/原型机/主
records.name: Prototype
records.des: Amid bursts of lively sound, Rebis makes another dazzling entrance. She seems a little different... Maybe her limbs look a bit strange, or perhaps she looks younger? "Huh? Who are you? Where the hell am I? Did something go wrong — never mind, come help me try this out!" Well, that's Rebis for you.
records.bookDes: It's that most familiar Tauri robot again — wait, what do you mean by the Stars robot?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/虔诚祈祷/分支-点头
records.name: Pious Prayer
records.des: Being among these people, you feel a sense of peace and tranquility... Soon, you notice that the dust you dedicated has increased. "What you reap shall exceed what you give. However, to leave is also an act of honesty, and no one shall blame you."
records.bookDes: As long as you make a sincere wish, your wish will be answered. This is the expectation of every resident of the Empire, and also the promise of the Tribunal.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/原型机/分支-为啥要帮你啊？！
records.name: Prototype
records.des: You catch the dice thrown at you. Just as you hesitate over whether to take the money and do the job, Rebis orders a robot to charge at you... accompanied by her maniacal laughter and shouting! "Don't run, just stand right there!"
records.bookDes: It's that most familiar Tauri robot again — wait, what do you mean by the Stars robot?

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/虔诚祈祷/主
records.name: Pious Prayer
records.des: In the warm glow, you see a group of people kneeling in prayer... Behind them, Lissandra stands quietly, as if unsure whether she is watching over them or praying alongside them. Seeing you arrive, Lissandra in red turns around. "Are you here to make a wish too?"
records.bookDes: As long as you make a sincere wish, your wish will be answered. This is the expectation of every resident of the Empire, and also the promise of the Tribunal.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/虔诚祈祷/分支-继续祈祷
records.name: Pious Prayer
records.des: As the dust you offer is given, the surrounding light becomes even more dazzling and bright — and within it appears what you need.
records.bookDes: As long as you make a sincere wish, your wish will be answered. This is the expectation of every resident of the Empire, and also the promise of the Tribunal.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/坚守者/分支-和他并肩作战
records.name: Guardian
records.des: The battle grows increasingly difficult; even working together with Dustin, you still can't deal with all the enemies. At this moment, Dustin suddenly looks at you."If there's no better way to break through, then we can only fight to the death. But if you wish to leave on your own, I will clear a path for you —"
records.bookDes: Even if transformed into a nonhuman body, he shall guard the flame in his heart.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/坚守者/主
records.name: Guardian
records.des: The sounds of battle come from nearby. A towering steel figure stands in the path of the enemies pouring out like a tide — that is Dustin and his weapon, "Celestial Fire." However, as far as you know, Dustin could not possibly be here. But if that really is him...
records.bookDes: Even if transformed into a nonhuman body, he shall guard the flame in his heart.

records.idCN: 奇遇事件/选项变化/坚守者/分支-上前帮助
records.name: Guardian
records.des: Perhaps this illusion is the result of a leak from Unbewusstes. From the content of his orders, you can tell that this is a memory of a battle from many years ago; he was the leader of the operation and was persuading the other members to leave him behind to cover their retreat.
records.bookDes: Even if transformed into a nonhuman body, he shall guard the flame in his heart.

records.name: Singularity

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度01/02第二位面/Boss1
records.name: Singularity
records.des: Didn't we already defeat him in the simulated combat system?! Why is he still speeding wildly —

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度01/02第二位面/Boss2

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度01/03第三位面/Boss2
records.name: Singularity
records.des: Effective load-bearing calculations can maintain a building's stability, but this overweight Chaos Behemoth has obviously come to the wrong place... Is it getting bigger and bigger?

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度01/03第三位面/Boss1

records.des: Poor visibility while exploring is a major no-go for adventurers. But having come this far, you can only grit your teeth and press on into the sandstorm.

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度05/03第三位面/Boss1
records.name: Singularity
records.des: Her resolve has already shattered, leaving her unable to defend anything. No one could blame her, yet she still torments her own soul.

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度06/02第二位面/Boss2
records.name: Singularity
records.des: "There, over there! That's the thing I was talking about that looks like a bird. Ah, yes, yes — do you see it?"

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度07/03第三位面/Boss1
records.name: Singularity
records.des: Created for the purpose of redemption. Now it has lost both the right and the chance to redeem.

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度07/02第二位面/Boss1
records.name: Singularity
records.des: The backwash of a righteous deed, the echo of the void, an incomplete knightly tale.

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度07/02第二位面/Boss2
records.name: Singularity
records.des: "You say you saw me with hair grown down to my heels? But for me to become like that, it would still take several decades...!"

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度07/03第三位面/Boss2
records.name: Singularity
records.des: She who climbs the ladder of truth. Now she falls deep into Unbewusstes...

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度07/01第一位面/Boss1
records.name: Singularity
records.des: Destroyer combat simulation offline. Dangerous Slayer individual detected nearby. Please stay safe.

records.idCN: 03Boss事件/难度07/01第一位面/Boss2
records.name: Singularity
records.des: Since Source Citadel has built an ultra-powerful defensive machine, it would naturally be placed in the location where it can function most effectively.

records.idCN: 回血事件/八音石02
records.name: Musical Rock
records.des: You hear the gurgling sound of running water, yet there is no water in sight. Following the sound, you stumble upon a massive, wondrous rock. It seems to weave an unparalleled exquisite melody from all manner of natural sounds. You can't help but pause and linger, lost in its tune.
records.bookDes: "In a distant land, I sing, I call... Let my hands become the arms of the mountain, let my branches become a song."

records.des: Proof of transcending world lines. Even knowing full well that we are destined to part ways in the end, would you still remain by my side?
